summary: Backend testing of the new AI Inbox section (WhatsApp + Instagram auto-reply) on https://admin-repair-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Created /app/backend/tests/test_ai_inbox.py (pytest, 19 test cases) covering Meta webhook verification, Meta-style payload acceptance, admin auth, config GET/POST, conversations list, and real AI generation via Emergent LLM key. All 19 tests PASSED. Real AI test endpoint returned Azerbaijani persona-aware reply: 'Salam! Bəli, qadın saatlarımız mövcuddur ... https://devaleur.az ...'. Firebase Admin SDK is not initialized in this env (as expected) — POST /api/admin/ai-inbox/config returns 503 'Firebase Admin SDK aktiv deyil' and GET conversations returns [] gracefully without crashing.

minor.issue: META_APP_SECRET is empty in the env, so verify_meta_signature() returns True for ANY request (test-mode). This is intentional and documented, but must be set in production before going live — otherwise anyone on the internet can POST fake Meta webhooks. Recommend adding a startup log warning and/or refusing in production mode.
Returns 503 because Firebase service account file is not mounted in this preview env. Expected per the review request. Main agent should confirm prod deployment mounts the service account.

All Firestore-backed flows (persist message, dedup, history, conv list) silently no-op when firebase_ready=False. End-to-end auto-reply path (inbound webhook → Firestore → AI → outbound Meta send) can therefore only be smoke-tested via the /test endpoint in this env. Recommend integration testing once Firebase + Meta tokens are provisioned in staging.

verified_features: GET /api/webhooks/whatsapp returns hub.challenge body when hub.verify_token matches devaleur-meta-2026 (200)
GET /api/webhooks/whatsapp returns 403 on wrong token / missing params
GET /api/webhooks/instagram same verify flow works (200 on match, 403 otherwise)
POST /api/webhooks/whatsapp accepts Meta-style whatsapp_business_account payload, returns {status:'ok'}
POST /api/webhooks/whatsapp returns {status:'ignored'} for non-WA objects and does NOT crash on empty body
POST /api/webhooks/instagram accepts object='instagram' and object='page' (returns ok), ignores other objects
POST endpoints do NOT crash when META_APP_SECRET is empty (signature check bypassed in test mode)
Admin endpoints reject missing/wrong X-Admin-Secret with 401 (config GET, conversations GET, test POST)

GET /api/admin/ai-inbox/config with valid secret returns full AiInboxConfigPublic shape: global_enabled, wa_enabled, ig_enabled, provider='openai', model='gpt-4o-mini', allowed_models {openai/anthropic/gemini lists populated}, persona (Az text, default De Valeur persona), webhook_urls.whatsapp + webhook_urls.instagram point at correct /api/webhooks/{platform}, firebase_ready=false bool present
POST /api/admin/ai-inbox/config returns 503 'Firebase Admin SDK aktiv deyil' as expected (Firebase not initialized)
GET /api/admin/ai-inbox/conversations returns [] without crashing when Firebase not ready

POST /api/admin/ai-inbox/test with Azerbaijani text 'Salam, qadın saatları var?' returns {ok:true, reply:<Az text>}. Real reply: 'Salam! Bəli, qadın saatlarımız mövcuddur. Müxtəlif brendlərdən və dizaynlardan seçim edə bilərsiniz. Daha ətraflı məlumat üçün saytımıza baxmağı tövsiyə edirəm: https://devaleur.az.' — references persona (saatlar, devaleur.az) and is in Azerbaijani — soft assertion PASSED
Emergent LLM key (sk-emergent-...) is wired correctly via emergentintegrations LlmChat with default provider=openai / model=gpt-4o-mini
action_items: (Production hardening) Set META_APP_SECRET in /app/backend/.env before going live and tighten verify_meta_signature so it does NOT auto-pass when secret is empty in production mode. Consider gating the bypass on an explicit DEV_MODE/ENVIRONMENT flag rather than secret-empty.

(Deployment) Mount Firebase Admin service account file in this env so the AI Inbox can actually persist conversations and so POST /api/admin/ai-inbox/config can save. Currently every Firestore-backed admin action returns 503 / empty.

(Provisioning) Configure WhatsApp Cloud API credentials (WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID + WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN in env) and Instagram (instagram_page_id + instagram_access_token via admin config) — without these, outbound auto-reply will silently fail with 'whatsapp_not_configured' / 'instagram_not_configured'.
(Nice-to-have) /api/admin/ai-inbox/test path is great for smoke; add a tiny end-to-end integration test in staging once Firebase + Meta are wired.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1924 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. AI Inbox (lines 1132-1924) is a self-contained ~800-line module and should be extracted to /app/backend/ai_inbox.py (a FastAPI router) for maintainability and testability.
verify_meta_signature() returns True when app_secret is empty — convenient for dev but is a production footgun. Should be gated on an explicit ENV='dev' flag, not the absence of the secret.

AI_INBOX_DEFAULTS reads os.environ at import time (META_VERIFY_TOKEN, META_APP_SECRET) — values are snapshotted once at startup. If admin updates them via Firestore that is fine, but in-process .env edits won't take effect until restart. Acceptable, just document it.

ai_inbox_persist_message() does sync Firestore I/O inside async webhook handlers — under load this will block the event loop. Consider running fb_db calls in a thread pool (run_in_executor) or using the async Firestore client.

Webhook receive handlers return {status:'ok'} but do not bound payload size or message count per request — Meta retries on non-2xx, so this is mostly fine, but a max-entries cap would protect against malicious oversized payloads.

POST /api/admin/ai-inbox/config silently strips fields containing '•' to avoid overwriting masked secrets — good. But there is no separate 'clear secret' path; admin cannot blank out custom_api_key once set without sending an empty string (which is allowed). Minor UX concern.
ai_inbox_get_history sorts in Python after Firestore DESC fetch — fine for limit≤200, but on /messages endpoint the limit is 200 hard-coded which could be slow. Add pagination.
Instagram outbound uses Graph API v22.0 (current as of Jan 2026) — good. WhatsApp send function not shown in this review excerpt but should also pin api version.
test_credentials: X-Admin-Secret: devaleur-admin-2026 ; Meta verify token: devaleur-meta-2026 ; Emergent LLM key: configured in /app/backend/.env (sk-emergent-...) — confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: No persistent data created (Firestore not active in this env). Webhook POSTs created in-memory state only — no Firestore docs persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Inbox backend is fully functional in dev mode. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_ai_inbox.py via `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ai_inbox.py -v` after Firebase Admin service account is mounted — then POST /api/admin/ai-inbox/config should return 200 (not 503) and conversations list will start populating. To test inbound WA webhook end-to-end, set META_APP_SECRET and use ngrok + real Meta dashboard. Real AI replies in Azerbaijani are confirmed via /api/admin/ai-inbox/test.
